planner_capacity_policy.target_open_focused_work_issues: 45-55 when legitimate approved scope supports it
planner_capacity_policy.immediately_executable_definition: Open current/earlier work with satisfied real dependencies, an authorized role able to act now, no live target claim or NVIDIA reservation, no blocking unresolved revision, and no required external wait.
planner_capacity_policy.parallelism: If executable depth falls below 10, prioritize genuine independent current/earlier Coder, Designer, integration, regression, verification or supporting decompositions after higher-priority Planner obligations; avoid unnecessary serialization but never weaken real dependencies.
planner_capacity_policy.anti_filler: Never create filler, duplicates, speculative/invented scope, artificial micro-tasks, fake eligibility or weakened dependencies to reach capacity metrics.
planner_capacity_policy.truthful_shortfall: If legitimate approved scope cannot sustain the executable floor, record the lower truthful count plus blocker categories rather than padding.
